traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and technical requirements in docs/stories/003.0-DEV-FUNCTION-ANNOTATIONS.story.md are fully implemented and verified: - Both rules require-story-annotation and require-req-annotation operate on the same set of function-like constructs and, when both enabled, ensure functions carry both @story and @req. - They share a common, well-tested JSDoc/comment parsing strategy (helpers in the utils and helper files), and expose consistent scope and exportPriority options. - Arrow functions are explicitly detected but excluded from mandatory annotation by default, matching the specification. - Error reporting is anchored on the function name (or nearest equivalent) and uses ESLint best practices with clear messages. - Robust error handling for malformed or missing JSDoc and edge cases is covered by dedicated tests. - TypeScript-specific constructs (TSDeclareFunction, TSMethodSignature, TS FunctionExpressions) are fully supported and tested. - Rule documentation files exist and describe behavior, options, and examples in line with the story. A fresh, verbose Jest run shows all relevant test suites passing, so the implementation for this story remains correct and complete. Therefore, the story is assessed as PASSED.
